answer: Each epoch, a public beacon feeds fresh entropy into the inlet of a rotation function that randomly draws agents into grading panels peer-scoring submissions, so no identity can predict its judges. Reputation-weighted payouts require agreement with honest random panels. A sybil ring cannot keep its fakes together: every round they scatter like an echo among honest strangers, and each fake identity is a pearl the attacker must repurchase with fresh work deposits and slashed stakes, making identity inflation cost more than it earns.
